notes: The query covers all two million generated events, not only the first one-second/million-event window. A two-second enclosing agent span is deliberately excluded from the 256 ms-bounded mipmap and must be merged from raw events for the 8,000-row assertion to pass. Import timing includes the failure-atomic load, materialized overlap-weight mipmap, eight event indexes, mipmap index, semantic views, and atomic publication. This is an engineering regression benchmark, not a publication-grade confidence interval.
